overnight.summary: US closed red Tuesday (S&P -0.24% to 7,734.77, Nasdaq -0.55%, Dow -0.16%) as US-Iran optimism faded and megacap tech dragged ahead of Wednesday's CPI [^1^]. Strait of Hormuz still blocked into week three — transits ~2/day vs 130-140 norm, US counter-reparations demand has frozen talks — Brent held ~$87.7-87.9 after Monday's +5%, WTI ~$82.2; Jazan refinery restart delayed to 8/30 after Houthi attacks [^2^][^3^]. Gold $4,448.6 (+1.1%), 10Y 4.69%, VIX 15.28 [^1^][^10^]. Asia Wednesday morning: Kospi +1.5% to 6,391.71 after Korea's Aug 1-10 exports printed +45.3% y/y with semiconductors +155.4% [^6^][^7^]. Tuesday's US tape was light-volume (book RVOL 0.4-0.9) and defensive — energy led (XLE +1.25%), Alphabet/Amazon lagged.
